meta.directive: Adopt wodniack.dev design language, animation, and composition. Preserve Mohit Shah content + existing color system.

recommended_pairing.display: Syne or Clash Display or unrestricted Bigger Display-class (Google: Syne)
recommended_pairing.body: Instrument Serif or Newsreader (Editorial New stand-in)
recommended_pairing.mono_ui: IBM Plex Mono or JetBrains Mono (Fraktion Mono stand-in)

hero.treatment: uppercase, huge clamp, tight leading, letter-stagger intro
hero.supporting_line: Available for freelance & product work → Contact

nav.style: uppercase mono 14px, tracking 0.05em, sparse — drop Client Guide to footer or secondary

first_viewport: One dominant motif: binary/canvas field using --brand tones (not red)

sections_order.job: Two paragraphs of biography — typographic, no tabs
Resume as quiet list (optional collapse from current tabs)
Mono chip rows or single column — not card tiles

add.name: hero_letter_stagger
add.lib: GSAP SplitText-equivalent or custom spans + CSS

add.name: section_inview
add.why: Replace generic ScrollReveal with class-driven choreography

add.name: work_horizontal_scrub
add.lib: GSAP ScrollTrigger or CSS scroll-snap + drag

add.name: binary_field
add.lib: Canvas 2D or DOM grid of 0/1 using accent color
add.why: Atmosphere motif remapped to blue accents

retire_or_demote: Header AnimatedBackground 300-particle field (too noisy for brand-first hero)
keep: Skills pen-split parallax (unique to Mohit — signature secondary motion)
motion_plan.reduced_motion: Gate all stagger / scrub / lenis behind prefers-reduced-motion

work_strip_spec.to: Horizontal media cells — one cell per project category or featured case study

cell.media: screenshot / looping mp4 / static art (use existing Behance & Netlify URLs)
cell.label: Title + tech mono caption
cell.code_motif: #ms-000n / total — decorative project index like wodniack #3vva-0000/34
cell.chrome: No rounded card chrome; edge-to-edge media with ink overlay on hover

component_rewrite_order: 1. Design tokens (styles.css / main.scss) — unify on canonical dark+blue set
2. Home.js / Home.css — brand-first hero + letter stagger + binary motif
3. Header.js — sparse mono nav, kill particle takeover
6. Skills.js — quieter layout; keep pen motif
8. Motion shell — Lenis + inview observer + GSAP optional
anti_patterns_to_avoid: Warm cream #F4F1EA + terracotta (wodniack surface is warm but we KEEP dark)
Rounded-full pill clusters & stat strips in hero
Copying Antoine's biography / awards / project names
success_criteria: First viewport passes brand test: remove nav → still unmistakably Mohit Shah
Colors match existing blue/dark tokens pixel-close
All existing project links & bio facts preserved
≥3 intentional motions: intro stagger, section enter, work scrub
Desktop + mobile both load; reduced-motion respected

meta.description: Creative Developer with 15+ years and 140+ projects, specializing in animation-driven, high-impact websites. Partnering with designers to craft memorable UX.
meta.og:title: AW - Creative Developer Freelance - France
meta.og:description: Creative Developer with 15+ years and 140+ projects, specializing in animation-driven, high-impact websites. Partnering with designers to craft memorable UX.

stack.media: 34 autoplay muted work videos + 2 canvas layers

color.notes: Bold monochrome-accent system: one saturated brand field, near-black ink, warm off-white surface. Contrast toggle swaps field ↔ ink. NOT a purple/cream AI cliché — high-chroma red.

layout.hero_budget: Brand (name), one headline (Creative Developer), one status line (available → Hire me), one dominant visual motif (QR + generative binary field). No stats, cards, or dual CTAs in first viewport.
layout.work: Horizontal scroll / marquee of large media cells — each cell is a project with looping video preview, project code (#xxxx-000n/34), and title. Full-bleed edge-to-edge, not a card grid.
layout.about: Two short paragraphs + awards list as typographic columns — no icon tabs, no GitHub stat cards.

motion.scroll: Lenis inertia scroll (html.is-loaded, is-scroll-blocked on intro)
motion.work: Horizontal scrub / drag + video autoplay on visibility
motion.cta: Oversized typographic GO / LET'S ROCK lettering animation
principles: 2–4 signature motions max (intro, section enter, work scrub, CTA)

composition_rules: One composition per viewport — not a dashboard
Brand is a hero-level signal (name + monogram)
No cards in hero; cards only when interaction requires a container
Full-bleed media plane for work, not inset rounded cards
Expressive custom fonts — never Inter/Roboto/system default
Atmosphere via generative motif (binary/QR/canvas), not flat fill alone

brand.name: Mohit Shah
brand.tagline: Crafting innovative digital experiences through design and development. Specializing in UI/UX design, web development, and creative solutions.

colors_canonical.rule: NEVER adopt wodniack red (#f40c3f) or cream (#fff0eb). Remap every pattern onto these tokens.

pain_points: Hero is centered text + dual CTAs + soft radial gradient — dashboard-adjacent, weak brand plane
Work is a 6-card icon grid — opposite of wodniack full-bleed media strip
About uses icon tabs + GitHub stat cards — dense, card-heavy
Fonts lean Avenir/Nunito/Roboto — generic vs expressive display+mono pairing
Motion is mostly ScrollReveal fade-ups — no signature intro / horizontal scrub / letter stagger
Custom cursor + particle header compete with content hierarchy

local: Local server offline — blueprint uses codebase scan + PORTFOLIO_KEEP
